subtopic: Mean, Median and Mode of Grouped Data
stem:
The following table shows the classification of number of vehicles and their speeds on Mumbai-Pune express way. Find the median of the data.

| Average Speed of Vehicles (Km/hr) | 60-64 | 64-69 | 70-74 | 75-79 | 79-84 | 84-89 |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| No. of vehicles | 10 | 34 | 55 | 85 | 10 | 6 |
note: The printed class list is internally inconsistent: 64 is both the upper limit of the first class and the lower limit of the second, and 79 is both the upper limit of the fourth and the lower limit of the fifth, while 69->70 and 74->75 leave the one-unit gap of a discrete (inclusive) classification. The intended classes are almost certainly 60-64, 65-69, 70-74, 75-79, 80-84, 85-89 — the book's own printed answer (74.558) is reached only from that reading, since it requires the true lower boundary 74.5. Transcribed exactly as printed.
